verdict.rationale: Lago publishes a full API reference with generated commands per endpoint, an OpenAPI 3.1 schema (verified live), versioning/stability guarantees, webhooks, and curl-based usage examples, all clearly documented and machine-readable (llms.txt, docs.md). This directly satisfies driving the product via a documented public API. Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on confirmation of API completeness/reliability beyond vendor docs.
